subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinservCorp
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finservcorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinservCorp

Alex / Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed next steps / POC plan so your team has something to review: 

What we covered
- Live demo of Redwood inference platform: hosted API + Dedicated options.
- Example throughput/latency profiles for gen-chat and embeddings for document search.
- Security controls: VPC peering, KMS key management, audit logs (SOC 2 artifacts available).

Suggested POC objective
- Validate Redwood can: 1) index and embed 1M transactional documents, 2) serve retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) queries at <= 150ms 95th percentile, 3) demonstrate basic fraud-alert assistant use case with acceptable cost.

Proposed timeline (8 weeks)
- Week 0: Kickoff + infra access (VPC details, API keys, test data scope) — owner: FinservCorp (Priya)
- Week 1-2: Data ingest + embeddings (1M docs sample) — owner: FinservCorp + Redwood (Marissa)
- Week 3: Baseline perf tests (latency/cost) — owner: Redwood (Dylan)
- Week 4: RAG integration + accuracy check (success criteria below) — owner: FinservCorp
- Week 5-6: Iterations + quantization/optimizations — owner: Redwood
- Week 7-8: Final report + handoff options (Dedicated or Hosted) — owner: Joint

Success criteria (example)
- Embed recall: >= 85% top-5 recall on curated eval set
- RAG assistant: >= 90% factual accuracy on spot-checks and no PII leakage
- Latency: <= 150ms 95th percentile under target load (50 qps)
- Cost: projected per-1M-docs inference cost within agreed threshold (we'll estimate once sample data is in)

Next steps
- If this looks good, can Priya share the test data access pattern and an initial eval set (50 queries) so we can prepare the ingest scripts?
- I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff for next Tuesday — proposed link below.

Attachments: demo recording, POC requirements template, draft SOW (stubs attached).

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0112
www.redwood.ai
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>

Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinservCorp

Thanks Dylan — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data scope: we can provide a 250k sample that mirrors the full 1M corpus (redacted). Priya will confirm connectors and S3 access.
2) Success criteria: the embed recall threshold looks reasonable. For the RAG assistant we also want F1 >= 0.75 on intent extraction for our fraud classes.
3) Latency: can you confirm whether the 150ms target assumes cold-start or warmed caches? Our baseline should reflect realistic traffic (warm).

We're broadly aligned on the timeline; need to check internal procurement timeline for any SOW. If you can share the draft SOW and estimated spend for a 6-week Dedicated trial, that will help expedite procurement.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Data Products | FinservCorp
alex.johnson@finservcorp.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finservcorp.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2027 20:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan - FinservCorp

Alex — thanks for the quick notes, great additions. Notes inline: 

- Data scope: 250k sample works for initial ingest; we'll size cost/throughput projections to scale to 1M.
- Latency: 150ms target assumes warmed caches and steady-state; we'll clarify cold-start behavior in the perf doc.
- Procurement: attaching a draft SOW and an initial estimate for a 6-week Dedicated trial (numbers are ballpark; Marissa will follow up with exact quote).

I've scheduled a 30-min kickoff for Tue May 18 at 10am PT — link: https://calendly.com/dylan-brooks/30min (please accept or propose another time).

Action items:
- Priya: share S3 access pattern + initial eval set (50 queries) — target Mon EOD
- Marissa: finalize quote and formal SOW by Mon
- Camila: propose tech kickoff agenda and list of Redwood infra contacts (low-level)

Attachments: 20270515-demo-recording.mp4 (link stub), finserv_poc_requirements.xlsx, redwood_poc_statement_of_work.pdf

Thanks,
Dylan

- For ingest we recommend S3 -> Redwood ingestion pipeline (we'll provide a small Python script). If you have PII concerns we can execute an on-prem redaction step prior to upload.
